messages:
maria: Hey team — first day and I'm stuck on Okta SSO. After I click the activation link from Google Workspace, Okta asks for MFA but my phone never shows the verify request. I tried Google Authenticator and 1Password; 1Password says 'device not enrolled'. Anyone know who can reset my enrollment or what I should do? @sam_it @kelly

sam_it: hey maria — welcome! most folks use Okta Verify or 1Password TOTP. can you share the exact error? screenshot helps.

maria: it says 'No devices enrolled' and 'Cannot complete enrollment'. Also got an email 'Okta device mismatch'.

kelly: @maria — IT can force-remove old factors. sam, can you check if her Okta profile shows a lingering factor? @it-bot

it-bot: New joiner onboarding checklist: maria — Google Workspace invite sent; 1Password invite sent; Okta activation link expires in 24h.

sam_it: looking... maria, what's your phone model? (iPhone/Android) and did you try reinstalling 1Password or clearing app cache?

maria: iPhone 13, iOS 16.6. Reinstalled 1Password, logged out/in. Still same.

kelly: ok. I'm going to remove any existing factors and re-send activation. give me a minute.

sam_it: also try using 'Okta Verify' app — sometimes Google Authenticator can't pick up push prompts for SSO.

kelly: done. removed factors and resent activation. you should get a new email. try the link and then open Okta Verify app when prompted.

maria: got the email. starting enrollment... okta wants to scan QR — copy-pasted into 1Password TOTP and it worked! I can sign in. thank you :)

kelly: great. I added you to the 'Engineering' group and updated onboarding checklist. you'll get 1Password vault access in a few mins.

onboarding-bot: maria added to #new-hires and 'engineers' group.

maria: one more Q — should I set up Google Prompt as backup or store recovery codes somewhere?

sam_it: yes please add a backup factor. we recommend 1Password TOTP + Okta Verify push or hardware key (YubiKey) for long-term. put recovery codes in your personal 1Password 'Recovery' secure note.

kelly: ping me if you don't see the 1Password vault. Also HR will send additional resources.

maria: thanks everyone! small hiccup but all set now. :partyparrot:
